# Vendored GSAP runtime

- Package: `gsap`
- Version: `3.14.2`
- Source: `https://www.npmjs.com/package/gsap`
- File used: `dist/gsap.min.js`

Haike Video copies this browser runtime into each HyperFrames workspace so
validation and rendering do not depend on network access. See
`UPSTREAM_README.md` for the upstream package and licensing information.
